feat: add custom exception handling and input validation (Level-5, A-Exceptions) - Introduce BraunException to represent application-specific domain errors. - Refactor command dispatch in Braun.java to use structured exception throwing and handling. - Add granular error diagnostics for unknown commands, malformed parameters, empty descriptions, and invalid task indices. - Update UI test plan to cover error test cases, boundary checks, and state integrity verification.
feat: add delete command and migrate to ArrayList (Level-6, A-Collections)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Replace fixed Task[100] array with dynamic ArrayList<Task> storage.
- Implement 'delete' command with input validation and out-of-bounds error handling.
- Update command dispatch and error diagnostics to support task removal.
- Expand ui-test-plan.md with test cases for deletion, list renumbering, and dynamic capacity.
